summary.name: Devin Desktop (formerly Windsurf)
summary.one_liner: Devin Desktop is the renamed Windsurf AI code editor, extended into a command center for managing multiple local and cloud coding agents from one place.
use_cases: manage multiple coding agents from one place
run long-running coding tasks with subagents
connect coding agent to Slack, Jira, Linear or Sentry
continue agent sessions across laptop and cloud
summary.what_it_does: Devin Desktop is the new name for Windsurf, built on the Windsurf IDE foundation with an Agent Command Center (Spaces, Kanban view, multi-agent management) added. It lets users run and manage agents locally or in Devin Cloud through the Agent Client Protocol, with sessions that can move between machines while keeping context. The page describes Devin coordinating subagents that each produce their own pull requests, a Fast Context file-finding feature, Devin Review for diffs, and Supercomplete next-thought prediction. It lists integrations with Slack, Microsoft Teams, Linear, Notion, Atlassian, Datadog, Sentry, Figma, Vercel and Stripe, plus language servers for Rust, C/C++, Python, and Go.
notable: Agent Command Center with Spaces and Kanban view for managing many agents
Agent Client Protocol (ACP) support for multiple agents and frontier models
Sessions can run locally or in Devin Cloud with shared context
Devin Fusion pairs a frontier lead model with a cheaper executing sidekick
caveats: Renamed from Windsurf; the page says only the name and branding change, with plan and pricing unchanged
Windsurf for JetBrains continues separately as a download
Several features (multi-agent support, custom background agents) are described as research preview or partner-specific
